description: Circuit is a Fabric mod for designing redstone builds before placing them in the world. Use a clean top-down editor to arrange gates, wires, inputs, outputs, encoders, decoders, and custom modules, then sync the finished circuit directly into Minecraft.

mods.name: Circuit
mods.description: A Fabric client mod for designing, saving, generating, and placing redstone circuit schematics from an in-game editor.
